Spyros and Makis Karaviotis perform at the Great Music Library of Greece "Lilian Voudouri" in Athens on October 18, 2026. This concert brings Greek artists to one of Athens' distinguished cultural venues.

The Music Library provides a setting that emphasizes musical heritage and cultural preservation. Artists performing here connect to Greece's rich musical traditions.

The venue's association with Greek musical history creates appropriate context for performances by Greek artists.

This concert offers Greek music at one of Athens' institutions dedicated to musical culture and heritage.
